package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious package or code is described in this article. The article discusses macro-level risks and challenges in software supply chain security, emphasizing the inadequacy of current tools and the complexity of modern software ecosystems, but does not analyze or identify any particular malicious code or package.

behavioral_signatures: Use of open source code with unvetted or unpatched vulnerabilities
Lack of runtime visibility into third-party or Nth-party components
Complex API interactions with insufficient behavioral testing
file_indicators: Presence of unmodified open source libraries with known CVEs
Opaque or black-box commercial software packages
network_indicators: Unexpected outbound connections from third-party or open source components
API calls to undocumented or suspicious endpoints
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Focus on comprehensive software supply chain risk analysis, including behavioral testing of all dependencies (not just direct third-party code), runtime monitoring for unexpected network or file access, and prioritization of patching based on exploitability and system criticality. Enhance visibility into API behaviors and require higher standards from all software suppliers.
